=== PAGE 2 ===
k= 4
For 55 ≤ h ≤ 302, n(h,4) and ai are given by one of the following three sets of formulae:
(A) : a2 = (9t+c21)
a3 = (4t+c31)+(3t+c32)a2
a4 = (7t+c41)+(2t+c42)a2 +(2t+c43)a3
n(h,4) = (2t+c51)+(t+c52)a2 +(6t+c53)a3 +(3t+c54)a4
(B) : a2 = (9t+c21)
a3 = (2t+c31)+(3t+c32)a2
a4 = (7t+c41)+(2t+c42)a2 +(2t+c43)a3
n(h,4) = (4t+c51)+(3t+c52)a2 +(2t+c53)a3 +(3t+c54)a4
(C) : a2 = (9t+c21)
a3 = (4t+c31)+(3t+c32)a2
a4 = (7t+c41)+(2t+c42)a2 +(2t+c43)a3
n(h,4) = (t+c51)+(4t+c52)a2 +(6t+c53)a3 +(3t+c54)a4
where h = 12t+r, 0 ≤ r ≤ 11, and cij are given in the following table:
r c21 c31 c32 c41 c42 c43 c51 c52 c53 c54 Valid for:
0 A 2 1 0 1 0 1−3 0 4−1 4 ≤ t ≤ 5
0 A 1 0 0 0 0 0−2 0 1 1 6 ≤ t ≤ 11
0 B 2 2−1 3−1 0−1−2−1 4 12 ≤ t ≤ 25
1 A 1 0 2 1 1 0 0 0 1 0 5 ≤ t ≤ 25
2 A 2 1 1 1 1 1−3 1 4 0 5 ≤ t ≤ 6
2 A 1 0 2 1 1 0 0 0 1 1 7 ≤ t ≤ 20
2 B 5 3−1 6−1 0 0−2−1 5 21 ≤ t ≤ 25
3 A 3 1 2 2 1 1−1 0 4 0 1 ≤ t ≤ 24
4 A 3 1 2 2 1 1−1 0 4 1 2 ≤ t ≤ 24
5 A 3 1 2 2 1 1−1 0 4 2 4 ≤ t ≤ 24
6 A 3 1 2 2 1 1−1 0 4 3 5 ≤ t ≤ 24
7 A 7 3 2 5 1 2−1 0 7 1 2 ≤ t ≤ 11
7 A 8 4 1 7 1 0 0 1 1 5 12 ≤ t ≤ 24
8 A 7 3 3 5 2 2−1 1 7 1 1 ≤ t ≤ 16
8 A 8 4 1 7 1 0 0 1 1 6 17 ≤ t ≤ 24
9 A 7 3 3 5 2 2−1 1 7 2 1 ≤ t ≤ 21
9 A 8 4 1 7 1 0 0 1 1 7 22 ≤ t ≤ 24
10 A 7 3 3 5 2 2−1 1 7 3 4 ≤ t ≤ 19
10 C 11 6 1 10 1 0 0 3 0 7 20 ≤ t ≤ 24
11 A 10 4 3 7 2 2 0 1 7 3 2 ≤ t ≤ 7
11 B 11 4 2 10 1 2 3 1 1 6 8 ≤ t ≤ 22
11 A 11 5 2 9 2 0 1 2 1 7 t = 23
11 B 12 5 1 12 1 0 3 0 -1 10 24 ≤ t ≤ 24
